author: Inside Edition
description: New details are emerging about the death of country music icon Dolly Parton. The singer and songwriter was hospitalized for four days before her passing at the Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Tennessee. Doctors had diagnosed her with cancer, which she battled secretly, out of the public eye, in her final days. Tributes are pouring in for the late country star, who died on Tuesday at the age of 80. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has the details.
title: Dolly Parton's Cancer Diagnosis Was Kept A Secret

author: Inside Edition
description: Hollywood is mourning the loss of one its most prolific and versatile stars: Tim Curry. The English actor portrayed the evil clown Pennywise in the 1990 miniseries "It," as well as the peavish hotel concierge in "Home Alone 2." But his performance as Dr. Frank-N-Furter in 1975's "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" cemented his reputation as an actor and singer with incredible range. Curry managed to keep working for years after a stroke left him partially paralyzed. He was 80 years old.
title: 'Clue' And 'Rocky Horror' Star Tim Curry Is Dead

author: Inside Edition
description: While she is being remembered as a multi-faceted entertainer, Dolly Parton's memory is also being honored as a philanthropist. Dolly donated millions of dollars to a wide range of charities that touched her heart of gold. One aspect of her legacy is her famous Imagination Library, which provides free books to children up to the age of five. She often signed the books "From Dolly the Book Lady." Inside Edition's Justin Finch reports on Dolly's giving nature.
title: Dolly Parton Being Remembered For The Millions She Gave To Charity

author: Inside Edition
description: The countdown to the end of the Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Massachusetts has begun. Final testimony will be given today, and closing arguments are expected tomorrow. Inside court, the debate continues as to whether Clancy was in the throes of postpartum psychosis, or was just a cold and calculating mother when she killed her three children in 2023. If convicted, Clancy faces life in prison. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano is at the courthouse.
title: Final Testimony Given In Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Rescue crews are searching for survivors after flash floods struck Nepal. More than 150 people are dead and around 400 hundred more are reported missing, many of them international tourists. CBS News reports 33 of the missing are American nationals. Reports say an earthquake may have caused part of a glacier to break apart and crash into a valley floor. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 33 American Nationals Reported Missing After Flash Flood In Nepal

author: Inside Edition
description: Not only is this baby extremely adorable, but he is extremely rare. This Wisconsin kitty name Erebus, is officially a Guinness World Record holder for the most toes on a cat. He has 29, to be exact. The previous record was held by a 28-toed cat named Jake. This gorgeous 5-month-old Maine coon isn't only unique, but he's a fighter. At 12 weeks old, Erebus battled aspiration pneumonia and fought to stay alive. Now he's healthy, thriving, and winning awards.
title: Kitten Is Born With 29 Toes

author: Inside Edition
description: Payton Bryan was diagnosed with a rare eye disorder called Coats Disease when he was a child. Coats is non-hereditary eye disorder that causes abnormal and leaky blood vessels in the retina, leading to fluid buildup and potential vision loss. Payton, who is a pitcher and baseball fanatic, is legally blind in his left eye but it never stopped him from participating in America's pastime. Now, the Nevada teen is on a full scholarship to Ottawa University in Arizona to pitch on the school's baseball team.
title: Baseball Player Legally Blind in One Eye Gets Scholarship to Pitch for College Team

author: Inside Edition
description: Natalie Hall from Ohio is living with three debilitating conditions, including a disorder in which part of her brain is pushed down through the opening at the base of her skull.
title: Woman Fights To Keep Her Brain Inside Skull #shorts
